name: How long does a typical flooring installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical flooring installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flooring installation project varies significantly based on the type of flooring, the size of the area, and any necessary subfloor preparation. For a standard room, laminate or LVP installation might take 1-3 days, while hardwood or tile could require 3-7 days, including acclimatization or curing times. Larger or more complex projects, such as those involving intricate patterns or extensive subfloor work, will naturally take longer. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flooring installation duration depends on material and area size; laminate/LVP typically takes 1-3 days, while hardwood/tile can take 3-7 days.
